payload.core_mechanism_summary: Nested loops: for each i>0, count how many previous scores are strictly less (large) and strictly greater (small); if large==i or small==i, increment result.
payload.rationale: The solution is a straightforward O(n^2) brute-force scan, not fitting any of the specific search subtypes. It does not employ backtracking, bitmask, branch-and-bound, graph search, or permutation enumeration. Among the candidates, search_backtracking is the least dissimilar default.
